pages.d: Invisible grills use thin SS 316 steel cables to protect balconies and windows without blocking your view. Child and pet safe. Get a free quote.
pages.b:
## What is an invisible grill?
An invisible grill is a safety barrier made of thin stainless steel cables stretched tightly between channels at the top and bottom of an opening. It guards balconies, windows and staircases, yet from inside it is almost impossible to see.
## How does it work?
The cables are fitted close together and kept under tension. A child or pet cannot pass between them, and the barrier stays firm if someone leans on it. Correct tension and strong fixing matter as much as the steel itself.
## Why SS 316 stainless steel?
We use SS 316 marine-grade steel with a nylon coating. It resists rust and weather, which suits balconies that face rain, sun and humid air in Jharkhand and Bihar.
## Where can you fit it?
- [Balconies](#/balcony-invisible-grill)
- [Windows, sliding and French windows](#/window-invisible-grill)
- [Apartments and high-rise flats](#/apartment-invisible-grill)
- Staircases, duct openings and terraces
## Invisible grill or iron grill?
Iron blocks the view and needs paint to fight rust. An invisible grill keeps the view and needs only a wipe. Read the full comparison: [invisible grill vs iron grill](#/post-vs-iron-grill).
## Care and warranty
Wipe the cables with a soft cloth and mild soap. Avoid harsh chemicals. Invisible grill work has a 10-year warranty, explained in our [terms](#/terms-and-conditions).
## Price and quote
The price depends on area, height and cable choice. See the [price guide](#/invisible-grill-price), or call 7061899614 for a free quote in Ranchi, Jharkhand or Bihar.

A balcony net is a strong knotted net fixed along the railing and ceiling to close the open sides of a balcony. It keeps children, pets and pigeons inside or outside as needed, and it lets light and air through.

We fit white and green nets. White blends with light walls, and green suits balconies that face trees or gardens. Both are weatherproof and made to last.

pages.d: Bird nets and anti-roosting spikes keep pigeons and crows off balconies, roofs and ledges. Get a free quote in Ranchi and Bihar.
pages.b:
## The pigeon problem
Pigeons nest on balconies, in ducts and on ledges. Their droppings damage walls and spread dirt, and the birds are hard to remove once they settle.
## Bird nets
A bird net closes the opening so birds cannot enter. We fit it tight along the balcony, window or duct, so it looks neat and does not sag. It works for balconies, AC areas and open terraces.
## Bird spikes
Anti-roosting spikes sit on ledges and parapets so birds cannot land and nest. Use spikes on flat edges where a net is not practical.
## Which one do you need?
- Balcony or duct opening: a net
- Ledge, parapet or sill: spikes
- Large building: [building nets](#/building-nets)
## Invisible grills and birds
With close cable spacing an [invisible grill](#/invisible-grills) can help keep birds out of a window, but for pigeons a net or spikes work best.
## Quote

## Why balconies need protection
A balcony is where children play and pets look out, and on upper floors a fall can be fatal. A normal railing is often low and has gaps. An invisible grill closes the whole opening without hiding the view.
## How a balcony invisible grill is fitted
Steel cables run from the floor channel to the ceiling channel across the open side of the balcony. They are tightened evenly so the grill feels firm. The cables are thin, so you still see the sky, trees and street.
## Child and pet safety
Cables sit close together so children and pets stay inside the balcony. Adults should still watch young children, because no grill replaces supervision.
## Material and finish
We use SS 316 marine-grade steel with a nylon coating, chosen to resist rust and weather. Trained installers fit it neatly, with strong fixing into the frame or wall.
## Balcony grill or balcony net?
A grill is stronger and almost invisible. A [balcony net](#/balcony-nets) costs less and also keeps pigeons out. Many homes use both. See [invisible grills](#/invisible-grills).
## Price and quote
Price depends on the balcony width and height. Read the [price guide](#/invisible-grill-price), then send a photo and size on WhatsApp. We work in Ranchi, Jharkhand and all Bihar districts.

faq: What is an invisible grill?

An invisible grill is a safety barrier of thin SS 316 steel cables fitted close together on a balcony, window or staircase. It protects without blocking your view, light or air. See [invisible grills](#/invisible-grills).
Are invisible grills safe for children and pets?
Yes, when the spacing, tension and fixing are right. Cables are fitted close together so children and pets cannot slip through. Adults should still watch young children.
Is an invisible grill strong enough for a balcony?
Strength depends on cable thickness, spacing and fixing. We suggest the right set-up after seeing your balcony. Send a photo on WhatsApp.
Will an invisible grill block my view?
No. The cables are thin and look almost invisible from inside, so view, light and air stay open.
Can invisible grills be fitted on windows and balconies?
Yes, on balconies, windows, staircases, ducts and terraces in flats, houses and offices. See [balcony grills](#/balcony-invisible-grill) and [window grills](#/window-invisible-grill).
What material do you use?
SS 316 marine-grade stainless steel cables with nylon coating.
Do invisible grills rust?
SS 316 marine-grade steel with nylon coating resists rust and weather, so it suits balconies that face rain and sun.
Do invisible grills need maintenance?
Very little. Wipe the cables now and then with a soft cloth and mild soap. Avoid harsh chemicals.
How long is the warranty?
Invisible grill work has a 10-year warranty. See [how to claim warranty](#/claim-warranty) and our [terms](#/terms-and-conditions).
How much does an invisible grill cost?
The price depends on area, height, cable choice and fixing. See the [price guide](#/invisible-grill-price) or send a photo and size for a quote.
Is the price counted per square foot?
Invisible grill jobs are commonly priced by the area covered. Send us the size and we will give you a clear quote.
Do you give a free quote?
Yes. Call 7061899614 or send a photo and size on WhatsApp. We can also arrange a site visit. [Get a quote](#/contact).
How long does installation take?
It depends on how many openings you have and their size. We confirm the time after seeing photos or visiting the site.
Can you fit it in an existing flat?
Yes. We fit invisible grills in flats and houses that are already built and lived in.
Does installation need drilling?
Fixing is usually done into the frame or wall. We explain the method for your balcony or window before we start.
Can I install an invisible grill myself?
We do not recommend it. Wrong tension or loose fixing makes the grill unsafe. Use trained installers.
Is an invisible grill better than an iron grill?
Invisible grills keep the view clear and resist rust. Iron grills block more view and need paint. Read [invisible grill vs iron grill](#/post-vs-iron-grill).
Can an invisible grill keep birds out?
With close spacing it can help. For pigeons we also fit [bird nets and spikes](#/bird-nets).
Do you work outside Ranchi?
